name: End-to-End Collaboration Journey
description: Demonstrates the complete user workflow: Login, selecting Foundry Showcase, workspace initialization, executing a Quick Action (brainstorming prompt), observing streaming thinking loaders/replies, real-time artifact creation/sync, opening the Canvas side-by-side panel, and exploring the real-time Activity Feed panel.
steps: Navigate to the entry URL http://localhost:8082/?enable-semantics=true
Wait 3 seconds for Next.js rendering and login page loading
Locate the text input field with label 'Username' and type 'admin'
Locate the text input field with label 'Password' and type 'admin'
Locate the button with text 'LOG IN' and click it
Wait 3 seconds for redirection transition processing and projects list loading
Verify the dashboard loads and locate the 'Foundry Showcase' card
Click the project card 'Foundry Showcase' to enter the workspace interface
Wait 4 seconds for the active workspace, resources, and tabs to load
Verify that the active tab is 'ANALYSIS' and the sidebar subtitle reads 'WORKSPACE EXPLORER - ANALYSIS PHASE'
Verify a dynamic chat session is active. If the list is empty, wait for a new default session to auto-create and highlight as 'ACTIVE' in the CHAT SESSIONS menu
Locate the QUICK ACTIONS section chip with label text 'brainstorming' and click it
Wait 1 second and verify that the command 'bmad-brainstorming' has been injected into the 'Talk to foundry' message input field
Locate the send icon button next to the message field and click it to submit the prompt
Wait 5 seconds for the system response pipeline to connect and trigger the streaming chat
Observe the dynamic 'EngagingLoader' progress state and the progressive text chunks appearing in the message bubbles
Wait for the streaming chat response to complete and notice the real-time file-write trigger
Verify that a new brainstorming spec sheet is successfully registered under the 'GENERATED ARTIFACTS' list in the sidebar
Locate the newly generated artifact row or title 'Brainstorming Sessions' and click it to inspect
Wait 3 seconds for the slide-out side-by-side Canvas Pane to open and render the rich markdown text of the brainstorming doc
Locate the notifications bell icon button in the TopBar and click it to toggle open the real-time Activity Feed sidebar
Verify that real-time event timeline cards (like the user inputs and workspace synch logs) are listed successfully in the panel
Take a high-quality visual screenshot of the side-by-side workspace split screen capturing the live project collaboration status
Terminate the session successfully
